newsitem.title: UK: Halifax says 97 starts well, outlook good.
newsitem.headline: Halifax says 97 starts well, outlook good.

text.p: Britain's Halifax Building Society said on Monday that 1997 had started well and that prospects were favourable.

"1997 has got off to an encouraging start. It will be another year of intense competition in the savings and mortgage markets, but we are confident we can deliver a good performance," the Halifax said in a statement from its annual meeting.
The building society, which will list its shares in June, said it was increasing sales at its financial services unit of personal equity plans, retirement products and unit trusts.
